title: Grateful Dead Live at Harpur College on 1970-05-02
source: reel> cass > cass; Nak Dr-1 > Lynx Studio Interface at 32 bit float / 96 kHz Weiss Saracon for BRC to 24 bit / 96 kHz by Jamie Waddell; Resampled from 96 to 44.1 khz in r8brain Pro > dithered in Izotope Ozone 3 (MBIT+, high noise shaping, 16 bit depth, normal dither, DC offset filter on) > exported to 16 bit in Audacity 2.0.0 > FLAC

ai_review.summary: A good‑quality partial recording that captures a stellar show highlighted by an epic Cosmic Charlie and a monumental Other One.
ai_review.review: The available tracks deliver a powerful performance with a ferocious electric set – especially the blistering Cosmic Charlie and one of the best‑ever renditions of The Other One – bookended by a soulful acoustic segment featuring Deep Elem, Candyman and Cumberland Blues. Listeners praise the clear, well‑balanced sound despite the recording being incomplete, making it a must‑listen for Deadheads.

ai_rating.rationale: Show is consistently described as outstanding with multiple standout jams; recording is noted as clear and enjoyable though incomplete, resulting in a high combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Sound is praised as clear and well‑balanced, but the release is incomplete (missing portions of the show) which limits the listening experience.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Acoustic set opens the show with intimate numbers, followed by a high‑energy electric set that builds to a ferocious Cosmic Charlie and culminates in an epic Other One; pacing is described as quintessential Dead.
